$comment: Machine-readable project status. Keep in sync with STATUS.md.

project.name: Blinky
project.tagline: Your key blinks. Blinky is why.

status.summary: Architecture documented end to end. The PC/SC + raw APDU decision is validated on real hardware by tools/PivProbe. No production code yet; next milestone is a building solution skeleton, then Blinky.Piv against recorded transcripts.

phases.title: Design
phases.done: Solution builds, schema script creates the PostgreSQL schema, SchemaValidator reports clean at service start.

phases.title: See the token
phases.done: Three different YubiKeys - factory, ykman-provisioned, blocked PIN - each report correct state in the database, with no write to any card.

phases.title: Issue something
phases.done: docker compose up, enrol a factory YubiKey from the console, and log into a Samba4 domain with it. No ADCS involved.

phases.title: ADCS
phases.done: The same workflow, console and audit trail against Windows AD plus ADCS, differing only in the profile's CA instance.

phases.title: The boring lifecycle
phases.done: Expiry produces exactly one renewal job; revocation regenerates and publishes the CRL; a blocked PIN is unblocked from an escrowed PUK with an audited disclosure.

phases.title: Console
phases.done: Every token and credential state is visible and explained; a credential's whole life is reconstructable from the audit view alone.

phases.title: Ship it
phases.done: A stranger can go from clone to smart-card logon using only the repository.

decisions.choice: PC/SC with raw PIV APDUs; no PKCS#11 module, no CLI wrapper
Built-in CA and ADCS behind one interface, both from the start
.NET for signing, BouncyCastle only for CMC and PKCS#7
PKCS#11 abstraction with file, SoftHSM2 and HSM tiers
Per-token HKDF derivation from an HSM-held master; no key material in the database
PINs are never stored in any form
Random per token, AES-256-GCM under an HSM KEK, disclosure audited
HTTPS REST plus a stateless SignalR doorbell; no broker
LocalSystem service plus per-session UI process
Agent proves the machine with mTLS; the user proves themselves with Kerberos from their own session
PostgreSQL with NHibernate, SQL schema script, SchemaValidator at startup
Built-in CA as a library inside api and worker, or its own service
Whether desk-side PIN unblock works without the backend

openQuestions.question: What exact CES authentication and delegation configuration is required for RA-signed enrol-on-behalf-of?
Should the built-in CA run as its own process so the key material sits behind a process boundary?
Should desk-side PIN unblock work offline with a pre-fetched, time-boxed PUK?
Ship a CLI-first v1 and defer the Angular console?
Which HSM in production, and does it need to hold the master key and the CA key in the same partition?

risks.handling: Validated 2026-08-19 on firmware 5.4.3 next to HID ActivClient: shared connection plus transaction, no contention. Hardware suite from patch 0011 keeps it honest
Read GET METADATA, fall back once, record Unknown rather than guessing
Backend registration refuses the combination up front
Verified as part of the phase 2 gate
Guard inside the agent step, not only in the server retry policy
Shared PC/SC connections inside transactions, never exclusive
AwaitingUser is a distinct state with its own longer deadline
